scope: Read-only native field audit at two complete saved checkpoints; no solver, controller, or threshold changes.

initial_t0_regional_reference.method: Initial fields have no native rho; phase masses are reconstructed from alpha.water, p, T, rhoWater=998.2 kg/m3, and the installed OpenFOAM perfect-gas R.

temperature_method: Use native common T for phase-weighted statistics; separately check T.air and T.water against T. The solver is one-temperature and no separate phase thermal field is asserted here.

native_volume_function_object_configurat.note: The tank function-object names say WaterVolume, but their configured integration regions are the full tank cellZones, including the small initial headspace/water-interface portion.

zone_method: Decode binary global constant/polyMesh/cellZones cellLabels as native global cell IDs. Zone masks can overlap, so zone rows are independent and must not be summed.
interpretation_limit: Temperature and pressure extrema identify where fields are cold/low but do not establish causation. The common T field cannot distinguish interphase thermal nonequilibrium; region-weighted differences locate the affected gas/liquid inventory only.
